news.title: Beyond the gotcha game: Moving from AI detection to verification-first supports stronger academic integrity
news.summary_en: AI, as they say, has entered the chat. The benefits of AI, when applied responsibly, can be a boon to the college and university environment, supporting instruction, study methods, accessibility, course design, administrative tasks and much more.

news.title: AACTE releases national framework on AI in educator preparation
news.summary_en: A new national framework from AACTE (American Association of Colleges for Teacher Education) aims to help educator preparation programs (EPPs) navigate the rapidly changing role of artificial intelligence in education.
